items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: He was putting together a new band... Artie's getting this band together... we got together, we went down and made a record... With Artie. 'Blues in the Night,' Take Your Shoes Off, Baby.

ctx.x: And Shaw was playing the clarinet.
Shaw was playing the subtone. He only played a chorus. Berley Middles, Arnold Brillhart's wife, played the harp and then we used whatever saxophones or whatever clarinets in the band.
I guess you knew Shaw from around New York anyway.
